findings.current: Xixia, Henan Province, where a tributary met the Yangtze, was packed with people as usual.
findings.defect: The draft makes Xixia the confluence where the tributary meets the Yangtze. The source only places Xixia alongside a tributary of the Yangtze.
findings.rationale: 맞닿은 describes Xixia as adjoining the tributary; it does not state that the tributary joins the Yangtze there.
findings.replacement: Xixia in Henan Province, situated along a tributary of the Yangtze, was packed with people again today.
findings.source: 장강의 지류와 맞닿은 하남성 서협(西峽)은 오늘도 수많은 이들로 인산인해였다.

findings.current: “I heard they arrived in Henan late the other day… Could they be here to join the alliance?”
findings.defect: The concrete arrival time, late the previous day, is weakened to the vague "the other day."
findings.rationale: 전날 means the previous day, not an unspecified recent day.
findings.replacement: “I heard they arrived in Henan late yesterday… Could they be here to join the alliance?”
findings.source: 전날 늦게 하남에 당도했다는 소문은 들었는데…… 설마하니 입맹(入盟)을 위해서인가.

findings.current: “You don’t seem to have much connection to Murim. Are you originally from Gansu? Or perhaps…”
findings.defect: The sentence's second possibility is omitted: the merchant may have picked up scraps of Murim knowledge from Third Rate swordsmen who patronized his stall.
findings.rationale: The omitted clause explains how an otherwise ordinary merchant might recognize the sect insignia and carries the young martial artist's contempt for the merchant's clientele.
findings.replacement: “You don’t seem to have much connection to Murim. Are you originally from Gansu? Or perhaps… you picked up a few scraps of knowledge from the Third Rate swordsmen who came here as customers.”
findings.source: “무림과는 별 연관이 없어 보이는데. 본래 감숙 사람이신가? 아니면…… 손님으로 받은 삼류 칼잡이들이 늘어놓은 풍월을 주워들었거나.”

findings.current: while the merchant’s longtime neighbors deliberately looked away from the scene.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the neighboring merchants had shared both hardship and good fortune with him, weakening the pointed contrast in their abandonment.
findings.rationale: 동고동락하던 denotes companions who had gone through joys and hardships together, not merely longtime neighbors.
findings.replacement: while the neighboring merchants who had shared his ups and downs all this time deliberately looked away.
findings.source: 그간 동고동락하던 이웃 장사치들은 애써 그 광경을 외면했다.

findings.current: His tone had changed, and so had his insulting words.
findings.defect: The sentence is both unnatural and semantically unclear. The source marks a deliberate register shift: the young martial artist has dropped his previously polite speech while openly insulting Blood Cudgel.
findings.rationale: 뒤바뀐 말투 refers to the change in speech level, a meaningful display of contempt and hierarchy.
findings.replacement: At some point, he had dropped his polite speech and begun hurling insults.

findings.current: A massive man eight feet tall had crushed Blood Cudgel’s head with a great cudgel and answered in a halting voice.
findings.defect: The draft reduces the specifically named 대초자곤, a jointed or two-section staff weapon, to a generic cudgel and also flattens the swinging action.
findings.rationale: 대초자곤 identifies a particular articulated staff weapon, while 휘둘러 explicitly describes swinging it.
findings.replacement: An eight-foot-tall man who had crushed Blood Cudgel’s head with a swing of his massive two-section staff answered in a halting voice.
findings.source: 거대한 대초자곤(大梢子棍)을 휘둘러 혈곤의 머리통을 박살 낸 팔 척의 사내가 어눌한 목소리로 대답했다.

findings.current: “How dare… insult Young Sect Leader. This subordinate… could not endure it.”
findings.defect: The draft turns the subordinate's continuing declaration that he will not tolerate such an insult into a retrospective claim that he could not endure it.
findings.rationale: 참지 않을 것 expresses resolve or refusal—"will not tolerate"—rather than past inability.
findings.replacement: “Dare… insult Young Sect Leader. This subordinate… will not tolerate it.”
findings.source: “감히, 소문주, 모욕. 속하, 참지 않을 것.”

findings.defect: The draft introduces a causal claim that the killing caused the trouble. The source only says the young martial artist expected trouble to arise.
findings.rationale: 말썽이 생길 줄 알았다 expresses anticipation that trouble would occur; it does not explicitly identify the preceding event as its cause.

summary: The draft contains one omitted clause, several altered concrete details, and losses in speech-level characterization and weapon specificity.
